messages:
alex_qa: Heads-up — customer acme-corp reporting negative tokens/sec and missing TTFT on Console since ~08:12 UTC. Dashboard link: https://redwood.prod/console/orgs/acme/metrics (screenshot attached). Happens for streaming route /v1/stream only.

sara_support: Which org id and deployment mode? Is this Dedicated or Hosted?

alex_qa: Org: acme-corp (org_7891). Dedicated in us-east. Customer says it started right after maintenance window (02:00 UTC). Ticket #12345 created.

tony_eng-metrics: I pulled raw events from the streaming_raw topic for org_7891. Offsets jump backwards around 08:10 UTC and our rollup delta calc flips sign. Suspect checkpoint/state restore + pod restart.

mira_eng-infra: Any deploys/rollouts for streaming-aggregator in us-east around 01:55–02:10? Pod restarts would fit.

zoe_prodops: Confirmed: streaming-aggregator v2.14.1 rolled to us-east at 01:55 UTC to address a GC issue. There were rolling restarts.

tony_eng-metrics: That matches. Quick theory: aggregator persists per-partition counters then computes delta = current_count - last_checkpoint. If state restore maps keys incorrectly or checkpoint is missing (reset to 0), delta becomes negative until new checkpoint is written. Also saw a checksum mismatch warning in the aggregator logs: "state-restore checksum mismatch for partition 7".

alex_qa: Customer provided repro steps (steady token stream). They can reproduce in staging by triggering pod restarts. Want us to validate and provide mitigation.

tony_eng-metrics: Repro steps I'm using locally:
```
# check kafka offsets around the window
kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.us-east.prod:9092 --group streaming-agg-us-east --describe --topic streaming_raw
# quick aggregate check in clickhouse/warehouse
SELECT route, sum(tokens) as s, min(ts), max(ts) FROM streaming_raw WHERE org='org_7891' AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL 2 HOUR GROUP BY route;
```

mira_eng-infra: Temporary mitigation options: 1) rollback streaming-aggregator to v2.14.0 for us-east (fast), 2) disable rollup job for affected routes (safer but may add latency/cost), 3) add a clamp in the rollup to treat negative deltas as 0 and emit an immediate alert.

zoe_prodops: I'll roll back to v2.14.0 for us-east now and monitor. ETA ~10m. :eyes: :ambulance:

deploy-bot: Rollback started: streaming-aggregator us-east -> v2.14.0 (triggered by zoe_prodops).

deploy-bot: Rollback completed: streaming-aggregator us-east -> v2.14.0 at 08:37 UTC.

tony_eng-metrics: Post-rollback check: negative deltas collapse and TTFT/tokens/sec metrics repopulate for org_7891. Looks like the v2.14.1 state-restore change is the root cause. Need eng-metrics to root-cause state serialization + add guards.

mira_eng-infra: I'll keep an eye on pod restarts and state-store logs for next 2 hours. If we see any checksum mismatch again I'll open an infra ticket.

alex_qa: Customer notified of mitigation and rollback. Updated ticket #12345 with timeline and ETA for permanent fix.

tony_eng-metrics: Action items: [eng-metrics] investigate state-restore checksum flow and partition-key mapping; add a defensive clamp so rollup negative deltas are zeroed and emit alert; add an end-to-end test that restarts aggregator and confirms metrics never go negative.

mira_eng-infra: Action items: [eng-infra] add extra monitoring on state-store checksums and consumer-offset jumps; coordinate with ops to avoid overlapping rollouts during peak ingestion windows.

zoe_prodops: Follow-up: will schedule a canary of v2.14.1 with state-restore fixes in staging and then a limited canary in prod.

alex_qa: Thanks all. I'll mark ticket as "mitigated - rollback" and keep customer updated with postmortem. :thumbsup:
